name: Yuuka Poolside
source:
The evening of the closing ceremony, just before the last summer vacation of high school.

Yuura and Natsumu are maintaining the pool together, but Yuura notices that Natsumu looks different than usual...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18125]Freem![/url]]
translation:
闭幕式的晚上，就在高中最后一个暑假之前。

Yuura和Natsumu一起维护游泳池，但Yuura注意到Natsumu看起来与平时不同……
